text: {"lessons":["I sold Stocks B, C, A, and D for gains, but those gains alone do not show that selling was the best choice; I should not rush to lock in profits for the emotional reward.","I should judge each stock by its future prospects, not by whether it is above or below my average cost; avoiding a realized loss can keep me in a poor investment, just as a gain is no reason by itself to sell.","My account rose over the later periods without any trades, reinforcing that I need not react to every price change. Since past moves do not predict future ones, I should trade only when my reasons support it."]}
